raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition under the Export Administration Regulations. Exporters of sporting shotguns, rifles, pistols and related parts should re-verify ECCN classification (many civilian firearms move to EAR99 or lower-control ECCNs), confirm license exception eligibility, and re-screen end users and destinations. Despite the relaxation, Section 301 tariffs, HTS alignment, and Entity List / restricted party screening remain mandatory. Reassess pending licenses, provisos, and recordkeeping obligations before shipping.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽了《出口管理条例》下民用枪支弹药的许可与分类处理。出口运动霰弹枪、步枪、手枪及相关零部件的企业应重新核实ECCN分类（多数民用枪支可能归入EAR99或较低管制类别），确认许可例外适用性，并重新筛查最终用户与目的地。尽管管制放宽，第301条关税、HTS归类一致性以及实体清单/受限方筛查仍为强制要求。发运前应重新评估在审许可、附加条件及记录保存义务。

checklist.desc: Re-classify civilian firearms, parts and ammunition under the rescinded rule; confirm EAR99 or reduced ECCN status and document the basis.
Confirm whether shipments now qualify for license exceptions (e.g., ENC, TMP, RPL) and update internal authorization matrices.
Map 10-digit HTS lines for firearms (e.g., 9302, 9303) against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin.
Run BIS Entity List, SDN and denied-party screening for all consignees, end users and intermediate consignees; retain records.
Obtain and retain non-transfer and end-use certificates for firearms shipments, especially to high-risk destinations.
Update EAR recordkeeping (5-year retention), reconcile pending licenses and provisos, and close or amend licenses affected by the rescission.
